name: route53domains
description: Amazon Route 53 API actions let you register domain names and perform related operations.

subcommands.name: accept-domain-transfer-from-another-aws-account
subcommands.description: Accepts the transfer of a domain from another Amazon Web Services account to the currentAmazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: associate-delegation-signer-to-domain
subcommands.description: Creates a delegation signer (DS) record in the registry zone for this domain name.

subcommands.name: cancel-domain-transfer-to-another-aws-account
subcommands.description: Cancels the transfer of a domain from the current Amazon Web Services account to another Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: check-domain-availability
subcommands.description: This operation checks the availability of one domain name.

subcommands.name: check-domain-transferability
subcommands.description: Checks whether a domain name can be transferred to Amazon Route 53.

subcommands.name: delete-domain
subcommands.description: This operation deletes the specified domain.

subcommands.name: delete-tags-for-domain
subcommands.description: This operation deletes the specified tags for a domain.

subcommands.name: disable-domain-auto-renew
subcommands.description: This operation disables automatic renewal of domain registration for the specified domain.

subcommands.name: disable-domain-transfer-lock
subcommands.description: This operation removes the transfer lock on the domain (specifically the clientTransferProhibited status) to allow domain transfers.

subcommands.name: disassociate-delegation-signer-from-domain
subcommands.description: Deletes a delegation signer (DS) record in the registry zone for this domain name.

subcommands.name: enable-domain-auto-renew
subcommands.description: This operation configures Amazon Route 53 to automatically renew the specified domain before the domain registration expires.

subcommands.name: enable-domain-transfer-lock
subcommands.description: This operation sets the transfer lock on the domain (specifically the clientTransferProhibited status) to prevent domain transfers.

subcommands.name: get-contact-reachability-status
subcommands.description: For operations that require confirmation that the email address for the registrant contact is valid, such as registering a new domain, this operation returns information about whether the registrant contact has responded.

subcommands.name: get-domain-detail
subcommands.description: This operation returns detailed information about a specified domain that is associated with the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-domain-suggestions
subcommands.description: The GetDomainSuggestions operation returns a list of suggested domain names.

subcommands.name: get-operation-detail
subcommands.description: This operation returns the current status of an operation that is not completed.

subcommands.name: list-domains
subcommands.description: This operation returns all the domain names registered with Amazon Route 53 for the current Amazon Web Services account if no filtering conditions are used.

subcommands.name: list-operations
subcommands.description: Returns information about all of the operations that return an operation ID and that have ever been performed on domains that were registered by the current account.

subcommands.name: list-prices
subcommands.description: Lists the following prices for either all the TLDs supported by Route 53, or the specified TLD: Registration Transfer Owner change Domain renewal Domain restoration

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-domain
subcommands.description: This operation returns all of the tags that are associated with the specified domain.

subcommands.name: push-domain
subcommands.description: Moves a domain from Amazon Web Services to another registrar.

subcommands.name: register-domain
subcommands.description: This operation registers a domain.

subcommands.name: reject-domain-transfer-from-another-aws-account
subcommands.description: Rejects the transfer of a domain from another Amazon Web Services account to the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: renew-domain
subcommands.description: This operation renews a domain for the specified number of years.

subcommands.name: resend-contact-reachability-email
subcommands.description: For operations that require confirmation that the email address for the registrant contact is valid, such as registering a new domain, this operation resends the confirmation email to the current email address for the registrant contact.

subcommands.name: resend-operation-authorization
subcommands.description: Resend the form of authorization email for this operation.

subcommands.name: retrieve-domain-auth-code
subcommands.description: This operation returns the authorization code for the domain.

subcommands.name: transfer-domain
subcommands.description: Transfers a domain from another registrar to Amazon Route 53.

subcommands.name: transfer-domain-to-another-aws-account
subcommands.description: Transfers a domain from the current Amazon Web Services account to another Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: update-domain-contact
subcommands.description: This operation updates the contact information for a particular domain.

subcommands.name: update-domain-contact-privacy
subcommands.description: This operation updates the specified domain contact's privacy setting.

subcommands.name: update-domain-nameservers
subcommands.description: This operation replaces the current set of name servers for the domain with the specified set of name servers.

subcommands.name: update-tags-for-domain
subcommands.description: This operation adds or updates tags for a specified domain.

subcommands.name: view-billing
subcommands.description: Returns all the domain-related billing records for the current Amazon Web Services account for a specified period
